candidats.description: A station on a natural gas pipeline used for the loading and unloading of pipeline inspection gauges, commonly known as "pigs". Photographed near Dübendorf, Switzerland . Additional annotations from the English Wikipedia by users Cadmium , Mannings , and BrutonD : This station is for loading or unloading pigs , the pigs are used for cleaning out or inspecting pipelines. This station is designed to receive pigs from the upstream section and launch pigs into the downstream section, with a cross-over for the fluid to flow from one section to the next. candidats.description: St. Francis of Assisi Roman Catholic Church, 150 Broad Street at Clinton Park, Tonawanda, New York, February 2023. candidats.description: "Labyrinth of the Mind" , by Erik Pevernagie , (100 x 100 cm) , Oil on canvas. DESCRIPTION OF THE PAINTING In “Labyrinth of the Mind,” Erik Pevernagie constructs an inner architecture of thought—an abstract yet intensely evocative environment where perception, memory, and imagination entwine. The viewer is placed behind a faceless figure, a blank head rendered in stark white, symbolizing the universal human thinker. candidats.description: It's concrete! In the photo the structure of high-strength concrete SISTROM. Cement stone white around the particles of sand. The strength of cement stone up to 150 MPa. The strength of the contact cement with sand is higher than the strength of the sand grains, so the grain of sand is cut by the destruction of the concrete. Even if the sand particles are granite or quartz. It is known that the sand contains large amounts of minerals. Thus we can study the structure of minerals or ancient shellfish (that are seen in the photo) using cement SISTROM.

candidats.description: The Philips Headquarters is a four story office building designed by The Bureau D’Etudes Henri Chomette (BEHC), who had offices located in Paris (France), Abidjan (Ivory Coast), Addis Abeba (Ethiopia), Ouagadougou (Burkina Faso) and Cotonou (Benin). Upon Emperor Haile Selassie's proposal to host the new African Organisation in Addis Abeba, the city underwent a significant urban reform in the 1960’s.
